review_notes: Reviewed all 99 lines, relevant Mathlib lemmas, and downstream uses. One localized simplification is justified. The proposed replacement was not compiled.

findings.excerpt:
unfold permutationDistance
  have he : permutationLinear π-permutationLinear ρ=
      (permutationLinear π-permutationLinear σ)+(permutationLinear σ-permutationLinear ρ) := by abel
  rw [he]
  exact (Submodule.finrank_mono (LinearMap.range_add_le _ _)).trans
    (Submodule.finrank_add_le_finrank_add_finrank _ _)
findings.problem: The intermediate equality restates the standard subtraction-cancellation identity and proves it with `abel` solely to rewrite once.
findings.proposed_change:
Replace the proof with:
by
  unfold permutationDistance
  rw [← sub_add_sub_cancel (permutationLinear π) (permutationLinear σ)
    (permutationLinear ρ)]
  exact (Submodule.finrank_mono (LinearMap.range_add_le _ _)).trans
    (Submodule.finrank_add_le_finrank_add_finrank _ _)
findings.benefit: The named identity exposes the same decomposition through σ without a separate equality or algebraic automation. The substantive range-and-dimension argument remains unchanged, including when r = 0.
